  {"step": 4, "file": "tinygltf/tiny_gltf.h", "function": "ParseImage", "line": 3874, "var": "img", "code": "return (*LoadImageData)(image, image_idx, err, warn, 0, 0, &img.at(0), static_cast<int>(img.size()), load_image_user_data);", "note": "The decoded image bytes and their size are passed to the default LoadImageData callback."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "tinygltf/tiny_gltf.h", "function": "LoadImageData", "line": 2401, "var": "bytes/size", "code": "if (!data) data = stbi_load_from_memory(bytes, size, &w, &h, &comp, req_comp);", "note": "The 17 decoded bytes are handed to stb_image's memory loader for format detection and decoding."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "tinygltf/stb_image.h", "function": "stbi__load_main", "line": 1040, "var": "s", "code": "return stbi__tga_load(s,x,y,comp,req_comp, ri);", "note": "stbi__tga_test() recognizes the bytes as a TGA (offset=0x54, colormap type=1, image type=9 RLE colormapped), so the TGA decoder is invoked."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "tinygltf/stb_image.h", "function": "stbi__tga_load", "line": 5528, "var": "tga_palette_len", "code": "int tga_palette_len = stbi__get16le(s);", "note": "Header parse yields tga_palette_len=0, tga_palette_bits=16, tga_width=7, tga_height=53513, tga_bits_per_pixel=16; tga_indexed=1 so tga_comp=stbi__tga_get_comp(16,0,&tga_rgb16)=3 (RGB), tga_rgb16=1."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "tinygltf/stb_image.h", "function": "stbi__tga_load", "line": 5590, "var": "tga_palette", "code": "tga_palette = (unsigned char*)stbi__malloc_mad2(tga_palette_len, tga_comp, 0);", "note": "Palette buffer is allocated with size tga_palette_len*tga_comp = 0*3 = 0 bytes; malloc returns a 1-byte region, so the palette holds no valid entries."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "tinygltf/stb_image.h", "function": "stbi__tga_load", "line": 5637, "var": "pal_idx", "code": "if ( pal_idx >= tga_palette_len ) { pal_idx = 0; }", "note": "In the indexed pixel loop, pal_idx is always >= tga_palette_len (0), so it is clamped to 0; the bounds check only compares against the entry count, not the byte size of the palette."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "tinygltf/stb_image.h", "function": "stbi__tga_load", "line": 5643, "var": "tga_palette[pal_idx+j]", "code": "raw_data[j] = tga_palette[pal_idx+j];", "note": "For j=0..2 the code reads tga_palette[0], tga_palette[1], tga_palette[2] from a 1-byte allocation, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ past the end of the palette buffer (ASAN: READ of size 1 at 0x6020000001d1, 0 bytes to the right of a 1-byte region)."}

7. Palette allocated with `tga_palette_len * tga_comp` = 0 bytes (1 byte actual)
8. Pixel loop reads `tga_palette[pal_idx+j]` out of bounds

Let me write the trace file.
